answer: Each submission hangs on the forge of a task receipt, and the lotus is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, capped per identity per epoch. What survives to the walnut is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short.
